component.name: PlayStash
component.summary: The self-hosted gaming platform for DRM-free games

description.p: PlayStash is a self-hosted gaming platform for DRM-free games. It acts as a central hub for your game library, keeps metadata and box art up to date, and lets you stream or download your games to any client.

developer.name: Alkan Alper, Schäfer Philip GbR / Phalcode
